name: YouNoodle

sources.title: YouNoodle — 'Launch better startup competitions, faster'; application/evaluation/community management for program organizers; 'Trusted by 6,000+ programs and 400K+ entrepreneurs'; apply portal at apply.younoodle.com

conditions: Pivoted — YouNoodle is now a competition/program-management platform (application, judging, community management for accelerators/governments/corporations); startups engage by applying to programs hosted on it (apply.younoodle.com), not by listing a product
requirements: For startups: an account on apply.younoodle.com, then applications to specific programs/competitions hosted there
For organizers: a paid platform license (Pricing page + Book a Demo)
SOC 2 certified enterprise platform — 15+ years, used by AWS Imagine Grant etc.
No product-listing surface — the catalog's 'directory' categorization reflects its old startup-network incarnation
preparation: For founders: browse apply.younoodle.com/showcase for open programs
workflow: Judging is run by the program organizers — YouNoodle is the infrastructure
watchFor: Purpose drift — this is competition infrastructure, not a launch directory
Program deadlines and eligibility vary per organizer
No backlink/listing value on the main domain
countsAsLive: A submitted application in a YouNoodle-hosted program — no public listing is produced
unknowns: Whether any public-facing startup profiles still exist
